gloss: to misunderstand; to misinterpret; to confuse

definitions.gloss: to put on the wrong shoes; to mix up footwear
definitions.explanation: To accidentally wear someone else's shoes or put shoes on the wrong feet.

definitions.gloss: to misunderstand; to misinterpret; to get wrong
definitions.explanation: To fundamentally misunderstand or misinterpret the meaning or purpose of something. Used figuratively.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}を{履|は}き{違|ちが}えた。
examples.english: I put on the wrong shoes.

examples.japanese: {居酒屋|いざかや}で{他|ほか}の{人|ひと}のスリッパを{履|は}き{違|ちが}えてしまった。
examples.english: I accidentally put on someone else's slippers at the izakaya.

examples.japanese: {似|に}たデザインの{靴|くつ}が{並|なら}んでいて、{履|は}き{違|ちが}えてしまった。
examples.english: Shoes with similar designs were lined up and I accidentally took the wrong pair.

examples.japanese: {自由|じゆう}の{意味|いみ}を{履|は}き{違|ちが}えている。
examples.english: You're misunderstanding the meaning of freedom.

examples.japanese: {権利|けんり}を{履|は}き{違|ちが}えてはいけない。
examples.english: You must not misinterpret your rights.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{優|やさ}しさと{甘|あま}さを{履|は}き{違|ちが}えている。

notes: Sense 1 is the literal meaning (putting on wrong shoes), while sense 2 is the more commonly encountered figurative usage. The figurative sense implies a fundamental, often stubborn misunderstanding, not a simple mistake. Transitive verb. Collocations: {意味|いみ}を{履|は}き{違|ちが}える (misinterpret the meaning), {自由|じゆう}を{履|は}き{違|ちが}える (misunderstand freedom).
